name: soloist_connect
description: Spotify Connect on Volumio 4 via Spotify Soloist, playing through pcm.volumio (ALSA, no Pulse)
author: Just a nerd

volumio_info.details: ALPHA - not ready for general use. Turns Volumio 4 into a Spotify Connect device using Spotify Soloist. Audio goes through pcm.volumio via a private apulse shim, with no PulseAudio or PipeWire. Requires your own Soloist API key from the Spotify for Developers dashboard. Unofficial and not affiliated with Spotify AB. The Soloist binary is downloaded from Spotify at install time and is not bundled. Includes apulse (MIT); see LICENSE and alsa-lib/LICENSE.apulse.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.3.0 (alpha): replaced the bundled promise, config and WebSocket helpers with kew, v-conf and ws. Fixes an error emitted on every WebSocket close, and rejects invalid settings instead of discarding them silently. 0.2.0 (alpha): Volumio 4 ALSA path (Pi + x86). Pulse removed. Control latency under investigation.
